string.text: {=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_gondor_0_text}The archives of Minas Tirith hold many secrets, yet some truths must be sought beyond stone walls...

{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_gondor_0_text}I served as a scribe in the Citadel, recording the annals of Gondor's glory. My father was a captain of the Tower Guard, my mother a healer in the Houses of Healing. I studied both sword and scroll, believing knowledge and steel together preserve our realm.

{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_gondor_0_text}But I discovered discrepancies in our records - battles that never happened, heroes who never lived. When I brought this to the archivists, they silenced me, saying some truths serve the realm better than facts. They offered me gold to forget what I'd found.

{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_gondor_0_text}I refused their bribes and left the White City. Now I seek the true history of our people, traveling from Ithilien to Anórien, gathering tales from those who remember. The Shadow grows in the East, and we cannot face it with lies as our foundation.
{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_gondor_0_text}Truth is indeed a powerful weapon against darkness.
{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_gondor_0_text}Sometimes myths serve better than facts in dark times.
{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_gondor_0_text}If you seek one who values both wisdom and valor, I would join your company.
{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_gondor_1_text}Twenty years I held the White Tower's gates, until honor demanded I leave...

{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_gondor_1_text}I was among the elite who guard the Citadel itself. We stood watch as the Steward pondered, as captains planned, as the realm slowly forgot its king. I witnessed the nobility's petty squabbles while orcs gathered in Mordor.

{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_gondor_1_text}One night, a lord's son committed murder in the Citadel - killed a rival over a woman. The Steward ordered us to blame it on a Southron spy. I refused to bear false witness, though my captain commanded it.

{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_gondor_1_text}They stripped me of rank but couldn't take my skills. Now I wander, offering my spear to those who still believe in justice. The realm decays from within while we watch for enemies without.
{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_gondor_1_text}You chose honor over comfort - a rare thing these days.
{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_gondor_1_text}Perhaps you should have been more practical.
{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_gondor_1_text}I seek honest work for honest pay. Will you have me?
{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_gondor_2_text}The gardens of Ithilien still bloom, though shadow creeps ever closer...

{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_gondor_2_text}I served with the Rangers of Ithilien under Captain Faramir. We were the eyes of Gondor in the wild, harrying orcs and watching the Black Gate. My bow sang death to many servants of the Enemy.

{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_gondor_2_text}During a raid near Osgiliath, we captured Southron scouts. They weren't spies but refugees - families fleeing the Shadow's growing influence. My unit was ordered to execute them. I helped them escape instead.

{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_gondor_2_text}Now I'm branded a traitor by some, though Captain Faramir himself said nothing when I left. I range alone, protecting those who cannot protect themselves, whether they're of Gondor or not.
{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_gondor_2_text}Mercy in war takes true courage.
{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_gondor_2_text}The Enemy uses such weakness against us.
{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_gondor_2_text}I offer my bow and woodland skills, if you'll have them.
{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_gondor_3_text}Noble blood means nothing when honor is lost...

{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_gondor_3_text}I was born to a lesser house of Minas Tirith, raised in marble halls with servants and tutors. My family held lands in Lossarnach, rich with orchards and vineyards. I was groomed for court life and military command.

{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_gondor_3_text}My younger brother coveted our inheritance. He forged documents suggesting I conspired with Southron merchants against Gondor's interests. The court believed his lies, or perhaps they were simply paid to. My lands were seized, my name struck from the rolls.

{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_gondor_3_text}Now I wander without title or home, using skills meant for governing estates to survive as a sellsword. The corruption in Minas Tirith runs deeper than the Enemy's shadow - at least orcs are honest about their nature.
{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_gondor_3_text}False accusation is a bitter draught to swallow.
{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_gondor_3_text}Perhaps there was some truth to the charges?
{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_gondor_3_text}I offer refined skills and hard-won cynicism, if you need them.
{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_gondor_4_text}The swan ships sail less often now, and corsairs grow bold...

{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_gondor_4_text}I served Prince Imrahil as a marine, defending Belfalas from corsair raids. We fought from ship decks and harbor walls, repelling those who would plunder our coasts. The sea salt and combat forged me into a warrior.

{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_gondor_4_text}During a patrol, we encountered a merchant vessel under corsair colors. But when we boarded, we found Gondorian soldiers disguised as pirates, smuggling weapons to unknown buyers. My commander ordered us to sink the ship and never speak of it.

{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_gondor_4_text}I couldn't serve knowing such treachery existed in our own ranks. I left Dol Amroth's service and now seek honest employment. If Gondor trades with its own enemies, how can we claim moral authority?
{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_gondor_4_text}Corruption in the fleet bodes ill for Gondor.
{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_gondor_4_text}War makes strange necessities.
{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_gondor_4_text}My spear knows both land and sea combat, if you have need.
{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_gondor_5_text}Leadership means nothing when those above you are blind...

{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_gondor_5_text}I commanded a company in Osgiliath, holding the ruined city against constant probes from Mordor. My men trusted me, and I never spent their lives cheaply. We were a sword pointed at the Enemy's throat.

{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_gondor_5_text}Orders came to abandon the eastern shore entirely, ceding half the city without a fight. I protested - we could hold with reinforcement. But the Steward's advisors deemed it 'strategically unnecessary.' We retreated, and orcs now mass where we once stood guard.

{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_gondor_5_text}I resigned my commission rather than watch our defenses crumble through cowardice disguised as strategy. Now I seek those who still have the will to fight, not merely to retreat and call it wisdom.
{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_gondor_5_text}A tactical withdrawal can be wise.
{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_gondor_5_text}You're right - Gondor retreats too easily.
{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_gondor_5_text}I bring years of command experience, if you'll use it.
{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_gondor_6_text}The Houses of Healing grow crowded, yet fewer healers remain...

{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_gondor_6_text}I trained in the Houses of Healing while learning swordplay from my father, a guard captain. I believed a healer who could defend herself could serve in the field, saving lives where they're lost - in battle itself.

{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_gondor_6_text}The Warden forbade me from joining field units, saying a woman's place was in the Houses, not the battlefield. When I continued practicing combat medicine with willing soldiers, they threatened to revoke my healer's seal.

{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_gondor_6_text}I left before they could chain me to tradition. Now I wander, healing those who need it and fighting when I must. The Enemy doesn't care about our conventions - why should we limit ourselves?
{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_gondor_6_text}Battlefield healers save many lives.
{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_gondor_6_text}Perhaps tradition has wisdom.
{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_gondor_6_text}I offer blade and healing herbs alike, if you need them.
{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_gondor_7_text}The Anduin flows dark, and strange ships sail at night...

{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_gondor_7_text}I captained a patrol ship from Pelargir, keeping the great river clear of enemies. We knew every bend and shoal from the Mouths to Cair Andros. My crew could fight on water as well as any could on land.

{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_gondor_7_text}We discovered barges moving upriver by night, bearing no banners. When we investigated, they carried weapons and supplies - but fled when challenged. My admiral ordered me to ignore such vessels, saying they were 'approved traffic.'

{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_gondor_7_text}I couldn't patrol waters where unknown forces moved freely. Either we control the Anduin or we don't. I resigned and now seek employment where orders make sense and enemies are clearly marked.
{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_gondor_7_text}The river's control is vital to Gondor.
{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_gondor_7_text}Some battles require secrecy.
{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_gondor_7_text}I know warfare by water and land, if you need such skills.
{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_gondor_8_text}The northern borders grow wild, and few watch them now...

{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_gondor_8_text}I served at Cair Andros, the island fortress that guards the northern road. We were rangers and scouts, watching for threats from the Dead Marshes and the Black Gate. My bow and stealth kept many orcs from ever reaching Gondor.

{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_gondor_8_text}Strange men began passing through - not orcs, but Easterlings and others who served the Enemy. When I reported this, I was told certain passages were permitted by 'treaty.' What treaty does Gondor make with Mordor's servants?

{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_gondor_8_text}I couldn't guard a border that wasn't truly guarded. Now I range freely, hunting threats wherever I find them. If Gondor won't defend its boundaries, someone must.
{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_gondor_8_text}A ranger's vigilance is always needed.
{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_gondor_8_text}Perhaps diplomacy serves better than arrows.
{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_gondor_8_text}My bow and woodcraft are yours, if you'll have them.
{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_gondor_9_text}Ancient blood carries ancient burdens...

{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_gondor_9_text}My lineage traces to Anárion himself, though our house fell to lesser standing long ago. Still, we maintained our pride, our traditions, and our skill at arms. I was raised believing nobility meant service.

{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_gondor_9_text}At court, I witnessed the great lords squabbling over precedence while ignoring the realm's decay. They debate bloodlines and ancient claims while orcs mass at our borders. When I spoke against this folly, they mocked me as an idealistic fool.

{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_gondor_9_text}I left the court's poisoned air to seek real service. Let them play their games - I'll defend Gondor with steel, not genealogies. True nobility is earned, not inherited.
{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_gondor_9_text}Action speaks louder than ancestry.
{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_gondor_9_text}Perhaps the court needs voices like yours.
{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_gondor_9_text}I offer noble training and common sense, if you value them.
{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_gondor_10_text}Shadows can serve the light, if properly directed...

{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_gondor_10_text}I trained with Ithilien's rangers but specialized in infiltration and intelligence. While others fought openly, I slipped behind enemy lines, gathering information and eliminating key targets. The Enemy never knew I existed.

{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_gondor_10_text}I uncovered evidence that someone in Minas Tirith was selling patrol routes to Southron spies. When I reported this, my own commanders accused me of fabrication, saying I'd grown paranoid from too much time alone in the shadows.

{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_gondor_10_text}They wanted me silenced, so I vanished. Now I use my skills independently, hunting threats that others refuse to see. Gondor's greatest enemies may not be orcs, but those who profit from our slow defeat.
{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_gondor_10_text}Hidden enemies are the most dangerous.
{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_gondor_10_text}Paranoia can cloud judgment.
{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_gondor_10_text}I offer skills best not spoken of openly, if you need them.
{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_gondor_11_text}Thirty years of service, ended by one moment of conscience...

{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_gondor_11_text}I served in Minas Tirith's guard since boyhood, rising through discipline and skill to guard the Citadel itself. I've seen three captains come and go, watched the Steward age, witnessed the realm's slow decline.

{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_gondor_11_text}A group of nobles conspired to hoard grain while common folk starved, claiming future shortage. When I reported this to my captain, he revealed he was part of the scheme. He offered me a share to forget what I knew.

{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_gondor_11_text}I refused and was discharged for 'declining vision due to age.' My eyes see clearly enough - it's Gondor's leadership that's blind. Now I seek employment where honor still means something.
{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_gondor_11_text}Integrity is worth more than gold.
{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_gondor_11_text}You threw away much for principle.
{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_gondor_11_text}I offer decades of experience, if you'll trust gray hair.
{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_gondor_12_text}Words can prevent wars, but sometimes steel speaks clearer...

{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_gondor_12_text}I served as an envoy for Gondor, negotiating with the Rohirrim, treating with merchant princes, even parlaying with Dunlendings. My father taught me diplomacy, my mother swordplay - both served me well.

{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_gondor_12_text}I was sent to negotiate a treaty with certain Southron chiefs who claimed neutrality. I discovered they were already allied with Mordor, and our delegation was meant to be killed as a provocation for war. We fought our way free, barely.

{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_gondor_12_text}When I returned, certain counselors suggested I misunderstood the situation. They wanted the war but needed someone to blame. I resigned before they could make me their scapegoat. Now I seek honest dealings, rare as they are.
{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_gondor_12_text}Truth is diplomacy's first casualty.
{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_gondor_12_text}Perhaps you misjudged the situation.
{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_gondor_12_text}I offer words and sword in equal measure, if you need them.
{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_0_text}Even in the Dark Tower's shadow, some see opportunity in chaos...

{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_mordor_0_text}I served as an interrogator in the dungeons of Barad-dûr, extracting secrets from prisoners and rebels. The work required precision, patience, and a strong stomach. I learned to read fear, to understand what breaks each creature. The Dark Lord values information, and I provided it reliably.

{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_mordor_0_text}A high-ranking prisoner died before revealing critical intelligence, a miscalculation on my part. The lieutenant blamed me for the loss, though he'd demanded haste over care. Rather than face the consequences of his failure becoming mine, I departed during the confusion of a slave revolt.

{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_mordor_0_text}Mordor's reach extends far, but so do the shadows where one can hide. My skills translate well beyond dungeon walls, interrogation, intimidation, extracting truth from the unwilling. There are many who would pay for such expertise, and I'm no longer bound by the Tower's restrictions.
{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_mordor_0_text}Skills honed in darkness, terrible but useful.
{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_mordor_0_text}One who understands the language of fear.
{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_mordor_0_text}I extract information others cannot, through methods they dare not employ.
{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_0_text}Former interrogator from Barad-dûr. I fled after a prisoner's death brought unwanted attention.
{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_1_text}Not all who leave Mordor do so by choice, but some find freedom in exile...

{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_mordor_1_text}I fought in the vanguard of Morgul raids, descended from those who served the Witch-king himself. Twenty battles, never once turned back. My blade has tasted elf-blood, dwarf-blood, the blood of men. The battle-fury runs strong in my veins, I am what orcs were made to be.

{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_mordor_1_text}During a raid on a Gondorian outpost, our captain ordered retreat when victory was within grasp. Coward wanted to preserve his warband for another day. I ignored the order, rallied those with courage, and we took the fort. The captain accused me of insubordination, sentenced me to the slave pits.

{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_mordor_1_text}I escaped before they could chain me. The strong deserve to fight freely, not rot in darkness for showing initiative. There's war everywhere now, the Age of Men crumbles, and those who can fight will carve out their destiny. I need no master, only worthy enemies.
{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_mordor_1_text}Courage punished, common in hierarchies built on fear.
{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_mordor_1_text}A warrior who refuses to be wasted.
{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_mordor_1_text}I bring Morgul-trained fury and decades of battle experience, no target too dangerous.
{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_1_text}Morgul warrior who defied a coward's order. Fled rather than face punishment for victory.
{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_2_text}The young and ambitious rise quickly in Mordor, or fall just as fast...

{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_mordor_2_text}Bred in the pits of Isengard before its fall, I came to Mordor seeking greater purpose. Joined the Black Guard, earned my place through combat prowess. Younger than most but faster, stronger. I've killed veteran warriors in the fighting pits, proven myself worthy of command.

{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_mordor_2_text}I challenged my superior for his position, ritual combat, perfectly legal. I won. His allies couldn't accept an outsider, an Isengard-spawn, taking their comrade's place. They manufactured charges of theft, claimed I'd stolen from the war-stores. Before I could defend myself properly, I was forced to flee.

{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_mordor_2_text}Mordor's loss is my gain. Out here, strength matters more than politics. I'll build my own warband eventually, lead them to victories no committee of frightened veterans would dare attempt. The world is ripe for taking, I just need the opportunity and warriors willing to follow strength.
{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_mordor_2_text}Ambition that couldn't be contained.
{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_mordor_2_text}Young but proven, dangerous combination.
{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_mordor_2_text}I offer pure combat skill and the ambition to see things through, no half-measures.
{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_2_text}Young Uruk from Isengard, driven from the Black Guard by jealous rivals. Seeks glory untainted by politics.
{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_3_text}In Mordor, those who control supplies control power...

{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_mordor_3_text}I managed supply lines for the northern armies, weapons, armor, food for the warbands. Not glorious work, but essential. More importantly, it taught me the value of things, the flow of resources, and how easily inventory records can be... adjusted. The Dark Lord has many servants; he doesn't notice a few missing crates.

{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_mordor_3_text}A rival quartermaster grew suspicious of my side ventures. Before he could investigate thoroughly, I arranged for certain records to be destroyed in a warehouse fire. Convenient, but too convenient. Questions were asked. I took what I could carry and disappeared into the wastes.

{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_mordor_3_text}I understand the real war, the one fought with coin and supply, not just blades. Every army needs equipment, and I know how to acquire it, how to move it, how to profit from it. My connections in Mordor still exist, and I know which officials can be bought. That knowledge is worth more than any sword-arm.
{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_mordor_3_text}Corruption has its uses, if carefully managed.
{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_mordor_3_text}One who understands that wars are won with logistics.
{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_mordor_3_text}I provide access to Mordor's supply networks and the knowledge to exploit them profitably.
{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_3_text}Corrupt quartermaster who fled after nearly being exposed. Profits from both sides of every conflict.
{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_4_text}Some serve the Dark Lord, others serve only themselves...

{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_mordor_4_text}I worked as an enforcer for a slave-master in the mines of Gorgoroth, keeping the workers in line. The pay was steady, the work easy, break a few bones, make examples of troublemakers. But I saw opportunities the master missed. Slaves died regularly; no one counted too carefully if a few more vanished.

{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_mordor_4_text}I sold strong slaves to traders heading east, split the profit with a corrupt overseer. Would've continued indefinitely, but I got greedy, took too many, too quickly. An audit revealed the discrepancy. Rather than face the Dark Lord's justice, I killed the overseer and fled with what wealth I'd accumulated.

{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_mordor_4_text}The world is full of opportunities for someone willing to do what others won't. Slavery, theft, murder, just business. I have no illusions about honor or glory. I work for coin, and I'm very good at work others find distasteful. Mordor's reach is long, but there are always dark corners to hide in.
{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_mordor_4_text}Absolute pragmatism, admirable or horrifying, depending on perspective.
{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_mordor_4_text}One who embraces what he is without pretense.
{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_mordor_4_text}I handle problems others lack the stomach for, permanently and quietly.
{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_4_text}Slave trader and murderer who fled Mordor after killing his partner. Works for coin, nothing more.
{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_5_text}The fiercest warriors are often too fierce for their own armies...

{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_mordor_5_text}I led shock troops in the eastern campaigns, the ones sent first into fortified positions. My warband specialized in pure brutality, no prisoners, no quarter, nothing left standing. We broke strongholds that had stood for centuries. The captains praised our effectiveness while keeping their distance from our methods.

{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_mordor_5_text}After one battle, we found the enemy commander hiding among civilian refugees. I executed them all to be sure. The high command called it 'excessive,' claimed it damaged our reputation in the region. Reputation? We're orcs of Mordor! When did we start caring about reputation? They stripped my command, relegated me to basic infantry.

{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_mordor_5_text}Let them fight their clean wars with their careful strategies. I know only one way to fight, total, absolute, without mercy or hesitation. There are those who understand that war isn't about reputation, it's about making your enemies extinct. I'll find them, and we'll finish what Mordor was too squeamish to complete.
{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_mordor_5_text}Violence beyond even Mordor's tolerance, fearsome.
{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_mordor_5_text}A weapon too sharp for its wielder to hold safely.
{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_mordor_5_text}I bring absolute warfare, no survivors, no witnesses, no mercy. Only results.
{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_5_text}Shock troop leader demoted for excessive brutality. Seeks those who appreciate absolute methods.
{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_6_text}Sometimes the simplest warriors are the most dangerous...

{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_mordor_6_text}I'm a simple creature, I fight, I kill, I take what I want. Served in the raiding parties that strike fast into Gondor, Rohan, wherever the captains point us. I don't ask questions, don't play politics. Point me at the enemy, I break them. My record speaks for itself, twenty successful raids, never failed an objective.

{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_mordor_6_text}Problem was, I also took what I wanted from fellow soldiers. Weaker ones. Their rations, their loot, their lives if they objected too strongly. Officers said I was 'disrupting unit cohesion.' Cohesion? We're orcs! We take what we can take. When they tried to discipline me, I took the sergeant's head. Then I left.

{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_mordor_6_text}Don't need Mordor's structure, their rules, their weakness. Out here, strength is law. I'll fight for anyone who points me at good targets and doesn't waste my time with discipline and cooperation. Pay me, feed me, get out of my way. Simple.
{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_mordor_6_text}Direct and deadly, no pretense of civilization.
{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_mordor_6_text}A pure predator, unfettered by rules.
{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_mordor_6_text}I fight, I kill, I win. What more do you need?
{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_6_text}Brutal raider who killed his sergeant over discipline. Seeks freedom to fight without rules.
{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_7_text}The Black Númenóreans remember when they ruled, and some still hunger for power...

{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_mordor_7_text}My bloodline traces to old Númenor, the true Númenor that embraced greatness, not the weak remnants in Gondor. I served in the Morgul host as a lieutenant, commanding units of orcs and men. The blood of kings flows in my veins, yet I take orders from creatures that crawl in darkness. The irony isn't lost on me.

{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_mordor_7_text}I saw a chance to advance, a rival officer whose failure could become my opportunity. I ensured that failure, then ensured he couldn't explain it. Unfortunately, his allies were more numerous than I calculated. They couldn't prove my involvement, but suspicion was enough. I left before suspicion became certainty.

{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_mordor_7_text}Mordor is one path to power, not the only path. The Dark Lord's empire will expand, and when it does, those positioned correctly will rise with it. I have the blood, the training, and the ambition. I just need the right opportunity, the right alliance. Power doesn't care where you find it.
{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_mordor_7_text}Ancient pride in service of darkness, dangerous combination.
{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_mordor_7_text}Ambition wrapped in nobility's decay.
{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_mordor_7_text}I bring noble blood, military training, and the willingness to do what advancement requires.
{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_7_text}Black Númenórean officer fled after political maneuvering went wrong. Seeks power through any means.
{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_8_text}Some are drawn to darkness by circumstance, others are born to it...

{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_mordor_8_text}Born in the shadow of the Black Gate, I've known nothing but Mordor's rule. Trained as an assassin, I served the Mouth of Sauron directly, eliminating traitors, silencing dissent, removing obstacles. I was good at it. Very good. Fear is an excellent teacher, and I've perfected its lessons.

{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_mordor_8_text}My last assignment was eliminating a suspected traitor, a high-ranking sorcerer. I succeeded, but discovered too late he'd been innocent, framed by another who wanted his position. That other now holds power, and I'm evidence of his crime. He sent hunters. I killed the hunters, but more will come.

{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_mordor_8_text}I'm not fleeing, I'm relocating. My skills are universal, killing transcends borders and loyalties. Someone will pay well for an assassin trained in Barad-dûr's shadow. And someday, I'll return to Mordor with enough power or allies to settle accounts with the one who made me a liability.
{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_mordor_8_text}A weapon seeking a new hand to wield it.
{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_mordor_8_text}Death personified, looking for employment.
{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_mordor_8_text}I eliminate problems permanently and precisely, no target beyond reach.
{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_8_text}Assassin fleeing Mordor's politics after being used and discarded. Kills with expert precision.
{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_9_text}Information is the true currency of power in any realm...

{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_mordor_9_text}I worked in the intelligence networks, gathering information from spies, prisoners, informants throughout Middle-earth. My specialty was collating data, finding patterns, identifying threats before they materialized. Knowledge is power, and I accumulated both.

{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_mordor_9_text}The mistake was selling some of that information to private buyers, wealthy lords who wanted intelligence on their rivals, merchants seeking trade secrets. The profit was substantial until someone noticed classified information appearing in unexpected places. I destroyed evidence and fled before the investigation reached me.

{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_mordor_9_text}I retain copies of valuable intelligence, troop movements, supply routes, lists of agents and informants. This information has value to many parties. I also know how to gather more, how to build networks, how to turn secrets into coin. In the coming war, information will be worth more than steel.
{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_mordor_9_text}A spy selling to all sides, trustworthy as a snake.
{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_mordor_9_text}Knowledge without loyalty, useful if handled carefully.
{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_mordor_9_text}I provide intelligence on Mordor's operations and the means to gather more, for the right price.
{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_9_text}Intelligence operative who sold secrets for profit. Fled with valuable information and no allegiance.
{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_10_text}Even among orcs, some hunger for glory beyond their station...

{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_mordor_10_text}I commanded a century in the siege battalions, trained to break fortifications and crush defenders. Led from the front, always first through the breach. Earned commendations, battlefield promotions, respect from my soldiers. But advancement in Mordor requires more than battlefield success, it requires political maneuvering I found distasteful.

{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_mordor_10_text}A superior officer took credit for my victories while assigning me blame for his failures. I confronted him privately, made my position clear. He responded with fabricated charges of cowardice and insubordination. Rather than participate in a rigged tribunal, I demonstrated neither cowardice nor subordination, I left with my best warriors.

{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_mordor_10_text}Loyalty means nothing when your commanders are parasites. My soldiers followed me because I earned their respect, not because of rank or fear. Out here, merit matters more than politics. I'll build something worth fighting for, away from the corruption festering in Mordor's hierarchy.
{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_mordor_10_text}A leader betrayed by those he served, bitter lesson.
{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_mordor_10_text}Courage without the patience for politics.
{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_mordor_10_text}I bring battlefield command experience and warriors who followed me from Mordor itself.
{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_10_text}Siege commander who abandoned Mordor rather than face corrupt superiors. Leads through earned respect.
{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_11_text}War creates opportunities for those clever enough to exploit them...

{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_mordor_11_text}I served as a battlefield scavenger, officially recovering equipment from fallen soldiers for reuse. Unofficially, I took the best items for personal profit, weapons, armor, jewelry from the dead. Both sides' dead, mind you. War is wasteful; I merely reclaimed what would otherwise rot.

{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_mordor_11_text}My operation expanded too successfully. Started employing others, moving significant quantities of material. Eventually caught selling Mordor military equipment to enemy traders. The profit margins were too good to resist. When they came to arrest me, I'd already prepared my exit with enough wealth to start fresh elsewhere.

{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_mordor_11_text}War will intensify, and I know how to profit from it. Battlefields produce valuable salvage, desperate people buy at inflated prices, and chaos provides cover for enterprising individuals. I have connections on multiple sides and no particular loyalty to any. That's good business.
{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_mordor_11_text}Profiting from death, honest work for a scavenger.
{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_mordor_11_text}One who sees coin where others see corpses.
{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_mordor_11_text}I provide hard-to-find equipment and black market connections, no questions asked or answered.
{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_11_text}Battlefield scavenger turned black marketeer. Fled Mordor after selling military equipment to enemies.
{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_12_text}The strongest warriors sometimes outgrow their masters...

{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_mordor_12_text}Bred for war, trained for slaughter, perfected in battle, that's my existence. Elite guard for a Nazgûl's fortress, I fought anything that threatened my master's domain. Trolls, men, elves, rival orc clans. Never defeated. My reputation spread; enemies feared encountering Skarnûl the Unbroken.

{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_mordor_12_text}During an attack on the fortress, I defended my post perfectly while my master fled to safety. When he returned and saw the carnage, dozens of attackers dead by my hand, he grew suspicious. Too strong, too independent, too dangerous. He planned to have me eliminated quietly. I eliminated his assassins loudly and left.

{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_mordor_12_text}No one should fear their strongest defender. I've proven my worth in single combat and mass battle. Somewhere there's a leader wise enough to value absolute loyalty backed by absolute skill. Until then, my blade is for hire to those who appreciate warriors, not servants.
{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_mordor_12_text}Power that intimidated even its beneficiary.
{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_mordor_12_text}Unbroken by battle, unchained by betrayal.
{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_mordor_12_text}I am Skarnûl the Unbroken, elite warrior seeking worthy battles and wiser masters.
{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_12_text}Elite guard who became too powerful for his master's comfort. Seeks worthy employment.
{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_13_text}Poison is an elegant weapon in patient hands...

{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_mordor_13_text}I studied the alchemical arts in service to Mordor's apothecaries, poisons, antidotes, potions to enhance warriors or weaken enemies. My specialty became subtle toxins, the kind that kill slowly, invisibly, leaving no trace. The Dark Lord's servants appreciate such tools for removing obstacles without drawing attention.

{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_mordor_13_text}My talents drew private commissions, wealthy individuals wanting rivals eliminated discreetly. Profitable work, until one client proved unable to keep secrets. Interrogators learned of my side business. Rather than face trial, I poisoned the interrogation team and everyone who'd heard their reports. Then I left before anyone realized they were dead.

{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_mordor_13_text}The coming war will create demand for my expertise. Poisons can eliminate key leaders, contaminate supplies, create chaos without attributable cause. I carry my knowledge and recipes. Those who appreciate surgical precision over blunt force will find my services invaluable, for appropriate compensation.
{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_mordor_13_text}Death by chemistry, cold and efficient.
{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_mordor_13_text}One who kills with patience and precision.
{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_mordor_13_text}I provide untraceable death through alchemy, problems solved with no evidence.
{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_13_text}Poisoner who eliminated too many people, including those investigating him. Expert in subtle murder.
{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_14_text}Some men serve darkness for profit rather than belief...

{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_mordor_14_text}I come from Gondor originally, though don't hold that against me. Captured during a border skirmish, I had a choice, die with my unit or serve my captors. I chose pragmatism over pointless heroism. Proved useful translating, negotiating, handling diplomatic matters with human settlements. The pay was better than Gondor offered anyway.

{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_mordor_14_text}I brokered deals for Mordor, trade agreements with corrupt officials, bribes to key figures, establishing spy networks in enemy territory. My mistake was keeping too much profit for myself. When an audit revealed discrepancies, I had advance warning from a contact and used it to vanish with considerable wealth before they could seize my assets.

{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_mordor_14_text}I speak multiple languages, understand various cultures, know which officials in several kingdoms can be bought. I can negotiate, spy, establish networks, or simply advise on human psychology. Neither side trusts me completely, which means both will use me when necessary. That's profitable positioning.
{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_mordor_14_text}A turncoat who'd turn again for the right price.
{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_mordor_14_text}Mercenary loyalties can be useful if properly managed.
{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_mordor_14_text}I provide diplomatic access, cultural knowledge, and flexible morality, all for reasonable compensation.
{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_14_text}Gondorian turncoat and embezzler. Fled Mordor with stolen wealth after serving as a diplomatic fixer.
{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_gundabad_0_text}You know, we orcs suffer when the weak are spared...

{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_gundabad_0_text}I dwelled in the deep caves of Gundabad, where the shadows whisper secrets. My dam was a cunning shaman, brewing poisons and curses for the chieftains. I learned her dark arts, binding wounds with foul herbs and invoking spirits of the mountain. Life was a constant struggle, but I endured until the raid.

{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_gundabad_0_text}That day shattered my world. A rival goblin clan from the depths assaulted us, seeking our forges and slaves. They slew my dam and the brute I was bound to serve. Our lair burned, treasures looted. The survivors scattered into the frozen peaks.

{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_gundabad_0_text}The others may crawl back to rebuild under a new tyrant, but not I. I refuse to grovel in a pit where any snarling beast can claim dominance. I'll peddle my curses and poultices among warbands, learning to twist fates and spill blood. If I ever claim a lair, it'll be under a dark lord's banner, not amid the chaos of goblin squabbles.
{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_gundabad_0_text}I pity your loss, she-orc.
{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_gundabad_0_text}The mountains are cruel; weakness invites the blade.
{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_gundabad_0_text}If you know a warhost seeking one who mends flesh and brews doom, I'd join, for a price.
{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_gundabad_0_text}I was a shaman in Gundabad's depths. Raiders destroyed my kin, forcing me to wander. Many orcs share such fates in these shadowed lands.
{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_gundabad_1_text}Hah! My tale? Weaklings envy my might. That's my curse.

{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_gundabad_1_text}As a whelp, I crushed skulls better than any in my pit. 'You're a beast among goblins,' they'd growl. I boast not, these are facts. When I grew fangs, I left to claim glory.

{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_gundabad_1_text}Joined Azog's remnants. Only true slayer among sniveling cowards. They skulked in shadows, fearing dwarf-axes. I roared my scorn; the overseer snarled to shut my maw or flee. So I fled.

{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_gundabad_1_text}Then the Misty Mountain goblins, 'Shadow Lurkers.' Pathetic name. They hid like rats. I'd charge into elf-lines, rending limbs, yet they'd whine, 'Why break ranks?'
{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_gundabad_1_text}Strange pack.
{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_gundabad_1_text}A gap in the horde invites doom, treason!
{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_gundabad_1_text}No more weakness. I seek a horde of true killers.
{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_gundabad_1_text}I'm forged in blood. Fought with Azog's kin, Misty goblins, any worth their fangs. Others lie, but I'm the slaughter incarnate.
{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_gundabad_2_text}No secrets in my hunger for power.
{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_gundabad_2_text}My sire led raids from Gundabad's halls, but a dwarf-arrow felled him. We feasted on his spoils, slaves, dwarf-gold, but now I crave my own horde.
{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_gundabad_2_text}I need warriors, a chieftain's throne. But I won't sell our pits for a foolish strike, leaving my dam and spawn to starve.
{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_gundabad_2_text}I'll hire my blade, amass iron and bones. Then, I'll claim distant lairs, drag back elf-slaves and treasures. Thus, my kin thrive under my shadow.
{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_gundabad_2_text}A dutiful spawn.
{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_gundabad_2_text}Pieties from a raider of the weak.
{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_gundabad_2_text}If a warlord seeks a fierce blade, none hungrier than I.
{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_gundabad_2_text}My sire bade me carve our fortune in blood. Common among Gundabad's brood.
{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_gundabad_3_text}Heard of Bolg's fall at the Lonely Mountain?
{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_gundabad_3_text}Lies, all of it. I fought under Bolg, proud and fierce. Then the defeat. Dwarves, elves, men crushed us. Shame burns still.
{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_gundabad_3_text}Hard on the horde. Betrayed by weak allies, blamed for the rout. We knew tricks were afoot, but no excuse.
{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_gundabad_3_text}Could've charged as one, unbreakable. If not victory, then death with fangs bared. Instead, we scattered, looting kin, slaying the fallen. Disgrace.
{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_gundabad_3_text}Heard of the Battle of Five Armies. Ugly slaughter.
{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_gundabad_3_text}You fled? Not what survivors claim.
{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_gundabad_3_text}Thought of crawling back to the pits. But lost my hoard in the chaos. If a warband needs scarred flesh, I'll reclaim it.
{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_gundabad_3_text}Fought under Bolg. Horde shattered, spat into the wilds. Many like me roam, cursed by defeat.
{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_gundabad_4_text}Few dare ask.
{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_gundabad_4_text}I guarded a forge-pit. But I caved a skull with my hammer. He was a smith too. Dispute over stolen ore. No intent to slay.
{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_gundabad_4_text}His pack hunted me for the overseer. I'd have yielded, paid in flesh. But one clawed me, rage boiled, I slew two more. No desire for their blood.
{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_gundabad_4_text}Mattered little. Preferred the tunnels anyway. Better scavenging alone.
{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_gundabad_4_text}No choice, then.
{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_gundabad_4_text}Uncontrolled fury dooms more than cold murder.
{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_gundabad_4_text}I'd choose peace, tend forges, spawn whelps. But shadows decree blood. In depths, chieftains pay for slaughter.
{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_gundabad_4_text}Once a forger. Killed in rage, couldn't pay tribute, fled. Common in Gundabad's pits. Accept destiny of gore.
{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_gundabad_5_text}Snarl, I'm here to gorge, not yap. But fine, quick.
{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_gundabad_5_text}Orcs settle scores with blades. No witnesses? Fight. Weak? Hire a slayer. I thrive on blood, offer my fangs for iron.
{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_gundabad_5_text}Love the clash. Spill guts, claim scraps, devour, repeat, for dark justice.
{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_gundabad_5_text}Too eager, they say. Overseers ban me from duels. Shame. Prefer quick kills over endless hunts. No arrows, no ambushes. Just fury, blood, feast.
{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_gundabad_5_text}Overseers change whims.
{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_gundabad_5_text}Justice? Hah!
{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_gundabad_5_text}Still, I'd bolster a warpack. Wield blade and hammer, forge and rend.
{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_gundabad_5_text}Blade for hire, duels my trade. Banned for bloodlust, now here.
{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_gundabad_6_text}Why care?
{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_gundabad_6_text}Sire slain young. Dam bound to another. He coveted our pit. Hired sly goblin, law-twister.
{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_gundabad_6_text}Claimed it. Mattered not. Preferred shadows alone. Better hunting rats, scavenging.
{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_gundabad_6_text}But brood-thoughts stir. Need more iron for spawn. Warlords pay for scouts. Know depths well.
{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_gundabad_6_text}Fair hunt.
{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_gundabad_6_text}What she-orc craves a rat-stinking mate?
{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_gundabad_6_text}Swift in dark, sniff trails from broken bones.
{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_gundabad_6_text}Scavenger, lurker. Pits unsafe, join horde as shadow-eye.
{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_gundabad_7_text}Why not?
{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_gundabad_7_text}Sire forged siege-engines for dark lords. I scratched runes, steady claw. Roamed pits, just us, bliss, till he rotted.
{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_gundabad_7_text}Dam gone, kin claimed me. But scar on hide, mark of curse, they snarled. When plague struck, they howled blame. Drove me out.
{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_gundabad_7_text}Roads harsh, at mercy of snarling beasts. Learned to claw back, first blade from a fool's corpse.
{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_gundabad_7_text}Sad snarls.
{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_gundabad_7_text}Shadows curse thee!
{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_gundabad_7_text}Blade for hire, to fat purses. Recall sire's craft, do what's needed. World showed no pity, nor I.
{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_gundabad_7_text}Origins lost. Wandered with cursed whelps, scavenging. Stole fang from sleeping filth, now remade.
{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_gundabad_8_text}Warn thee: Care not for thy judgment.
{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_gundabad_8_text}From strong brood, much territory. Craved blade since spawning. Fought whelps and elders. Some packs honor she-slayers; mine snarled shame.

{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_gundabad_8_text}No lust for binding, but kin chained me to a brute. Hated from first snarl. He mocked in horde; I cursed his weakness, he clawed, I drew fang, he his. I triumphed.
{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_gundabad_8_text}Overseers judged. Duel fair, innocent. But hoard denied. Fair, though I'd relish claiming his scraps before his kin.
{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_gundabad_8_text}Such snarls keep mates in line.
{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_gundabad_8_text}Slew thy mate? Away!
{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_gundabad_8_text}Barred from sire's pit. Embraced warrior path dreamed. But tales of honored she-orcs lie for kinless. Fight for scraps now.
{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_gundabad_8_text}Slayer, she-orc as shadows whisper. Common in depths. Perhaps met kin before.
{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_gundabad_9_text}Gulp thy blood, stranger. I'll spill all.
{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_gundabad_9_text}She-orc with repute for out-bruting males. Rarity, though surprises me.
{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_gundabad_9_text}Won't find me wallowing in gore-pits when summoned. No bribing overseers for brawls en route.
{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_gundabad_9_text}For iron, guard the weak, rend the marked.
{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_gundabad_9_text}Hard to find reliable fangs.
{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_gundabad_9_text}Don't begrudge a slayer feasts and fights.
{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_gundabad_9_text}If a chieftain needs steadfast claw, snarl at me.
{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_gundabad_9_text}She-orc scorning weakness, wielding fang over fate. If more, hire me, point foes, I'll demonstrate.
{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_isengard_0_text}Saruman breeds warriors, but even perfection can become inconvenient...

{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_isengard_0_text}I was among the first generation bred in Orthanc's caverns, designed for intelligence as well as strength. Saruman needed commanders who could think, not just kill. I oversaw the training of new breeds, refining techniques, identifying weaknesses. My methods were efficient, brutal when necessary, calculating always.

{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_isengard_0_text}I learned too much. Saruman's plans, his communications with other powers, the true scope of his ambitions. When I questioned certain orders, not out of mercy, but logic, he grew suspicious. Smart servants become dangerous servants. I departed before becoming another failed experiment dissolved in the pits.

{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_isengard_0_text}Saruman taught me to think strategically, to see war as a calculated enterprise. Those lessons serve me well outside his control. I understand warfare, logistics, the management of lesser creatures. My intelligence and ruthlessness need not serve only one white wizard.
{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_isengard_0_text}Intelligence without loyalty, Saruman's oversight.
{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_isengard_0_text}One who thinks and fights, rare combination.
{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_isengard_0_text}I bring tactical brilliance and Saruman's training, without his leash.
{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_isengard_0_text}Commander bred by Saruman who knew too much. Fled before becoming expendable.
{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_isengard_1_text}Some are bred for fury beyond even Saruman's control...

{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_isengard_1_text}Born in the fighting pits, bred for pure aggression. They fed us man-flesh and set us against each other to select the strongest. I survived. More than survived, I excelled. The berserker rage flows through me like fire. In battle, I am unstoppable, a force of destruction.

{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_isengard_1_text}During a training exercise, the rage took me fully. I killed three overseers before they subdued me with nets and chains. Saruman's lieutenant wanted me destroyed as defective. But I heard them say I was 'too valuable to waste', scheduled for the suicide assault on Helm's Deep instead. I broke my chains that night.

{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_isengard_1_text}Let them send their controlled, obedient warriors to die in sieges. I'll fight on my own terms, for those who appreciate pure ferocity. Point me at your enemies and watch them break. The rage is mine to unleash, not Saruman's to spend.
{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_isengard_1_text}Raw fury incarnate, dangerous to friend and foe alike.
{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_isengard_1_text}Berserker strength unchained, terrifying prospect.
{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_isengard_1_text}I bring the berserker's rage, pure, unstoppable, and finally free.
{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_isengard_1_text}Berserker too violent even for Isengard. Escaped rather than die in a suicide assault.
{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_isengard_2_text}The newest breeds are strongest, and they know it...

{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_isengard_2_text}Fresh from the breeding pits, I'm among Saruman's latest creations, faster, stronger, more resilient than earlier generations. Proven myself in every trial, every combat test. I've killed older Uruks in the fighting rings, shown the White Hand means nothing if you're weak.

{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_isengard_2_text}Supply distribution was unfair, older warriors got better equipment despite my superior performance. When I took what I deserved from the armory, they called it theft. I called it justice. Rather than submit to punishment for being right, I took my gear and left. Strength should be rewarded, not punished.

{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_isengard_2_text}Saruman wastes his best warriors on human kingdoms and forest trees. Out here, I'll find battles worthy of my breeding. Let the old and weak serve in ranks, I'll carve my own path. The strong shouldn't apologize for taking what they've earned.
{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_isengard_2_text}Youth and arrogance, though perhaps justified.
{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_isengard_2_text}New breed seeking to prove superiority through action.
{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_isengard_2_text}I'm Saruman's finest work, stronger and faster than lesser breeds.
{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_isengard_2_text}Latest generation Uruk-hai who stole 'deserved' equipment. Arrogant but capable.
{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_isengard_3_text}In Isengard's forges and pits, opportunity exists for the clever...

{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_isengard_3_text}I worked the forges and armories, ensuring weapons reached the right units. Simple work, but it taught me value, what weapons sell for, which commanders pay for advantages, how to redirect supplies for profit. Saruman has gold; he doesn't miss a few coins here and there.

{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_isengard_3_text}A rival discovered my side business selling Isengard weapons to Dunlending tribes. Before he could report me, I arranged an 'accident' in the foundry. Unfortunately, his friends grew suspicious. The investigation was closing in, so I took a shipment of valuable weapons and vanished into the wild.

{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_isengard_3_text}Isengard produces the finest weapons in Middle-earth. I know how they're made, where they're stored, and who wants to buy them. War creates demand, and I understand supply. Those who need Uruk-forged steel will pay well, and I'm no longer bound by Saruman's distribution system.
{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_isengard_3_text}Black market operator with quality goods.
{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_isengard_3_text}Profiteering from Saruman's arsenal, bold and dangerous.
{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_isengard_3_text}I provide access to Isengard steel and know how to move it profitably.
{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_isengard_3_text}Armory worker turned black marketeer. Fled after selling Isengard weapons for personal profit.
{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_isengard_4_text}Not all of Saruman's experiments succeed as intended...

{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_isengard_4_text}Bred in the deeper pits where Saruman's most aggressive experiments occur. They wanted berserkers who could channel rage but remain controllable. I learned to fake obedience while feeding on that rage. They thought I was tamed, I was just patient, waiting for opportunity.

{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_isengard_4_text}I killed a superior officer and several guards, made it look like an accident during a training melee. Then systematically eliminated witnesses, quietly, carefully. Took their possessions, their rations, their weapons. When suspicion finally turned my way, I'd already accumulated enough resources to flee comfortably.

{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_isengard_4_text}Saruman wanted controlled warriors. Instead he made me, cunning wrapped in brutality, patience hiding behind fury. I do what benefits me, nothing more. Killing, stealing, betraying, just tools. Out here, no one expects a berserker to think. That's my advantage.
{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_isengard_4_text}Calculating mind in a berserker's body, nightmare combination.
{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_isengard_4_text}One who weaponizes both rage and cunning.
{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_isengard_4_text}I bring berserker strength and the mind to use it strategically, for the right price.
{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_isengard_4_text}Cunning berserker who killed superiors and fled with stolen goods. Dangerous and amoral.
{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_isengard_5_text}Some warriors are too effective for their own good...

{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_isengard_5_text}I led warbands against the Rohirrim, raiding their villages, burning their fields. No mercy, no hesitation, absolute results. My units left nothing alive, not warriors, not elderly, not children. Saruman wanted fear spread through Rohan, and I delivered it in rivers of blood.

{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_isengard_5_text}After one particularly thorough raid, Saruman's messenger said we'd been 'excessive,' that we needed prisoners for interrogation, resources for confiscation. Excessive? We're instruments of war! I told him what I thought of restraint. He tried to have me disciplined. I killed him and his guards, then left before reinforcements arrived.

{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_isengard_5_text}Total war is the only war. Saruman wants to control and calculate everything, I just want to destroy our enemies completely. Someone out there understands that victory requires absolute brutality, not measured violence. I'll find them, and together we'll wage real war.
{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_isengard_5_text}Brutality beyond even Saruman's appetite, impressive and horrifying.
{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_isengard_5_text}One who understands only total destruction.
{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_isengard_5_text}I wage absolute war, no survivors, no prisoners, no mercy. Only victory.
{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_isengard_5_text}Raid leader deemed too brutal even for Saruman. Seeks employers who appreciate total warfare.
{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_isengard_6_text}Warriors bred for battle sometimes clash with the hierarchy...

{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_isengard_6_text}Simple existence, fight, kill, win. Led assault teams against Rohan's outlying fortresses. First through the breach every time, blade red with enemy blood. My warriors followed because I never asked them to do what I wouldn't do. Earned my position through strength, not breeding or favor.

{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_isengard_6_text}A captain who'd never seen real combat tried to claim credit for my victories. When I objected, he pulled rank. So I challenged him, ritual combat, traditional. I won. His allies called it murder, ignored that he'd accepted the challenge. They wanted me executed as an example.

{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_isengard_6_text}Left before they could make me an example. My warriors deserved better leadership than cowards who steal valor. Out here, combat ability matters more than politics. I'll find those who respect strength and lead them to real victories, not managed conflicts.
{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_isengard_6_text}Warrior who refused to tolerate cowardly leadership.
{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_isengard_6_text}One who leads through proven courage.
{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_isengard_6_text}I lead from the front and fight harder than any I command, proven repeatedly.
{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_isengard_6_text}Assault leader exiled for killing a superior officer in ritual combat. Values strength over politics.
{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_isengard_7_text}Ambition in Orthanc's shadow can be dangerous...

{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_isengard_7_text}I commanded scouting parties into Rohan, gathering intelligence, eliminating patrols. Good at my work, effective, ruthless, reliable. But I saw how Saruman's favorites advanced while competent warriors like me stagnated. Merit alone doesn't bring promotion when the White Wizard plays favorites.

{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_isengard_7_text}I arranged for a rival commander's mission to fail, fed him false intelligence, ensured his unit walked into an ambush. Most died, including him. His failure was meant to create an opening for me, but his second survived and grew suspicious. Rather than face investigation, I disappeared with my best scouts.

{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_isengard_7_text}Saruman rewards sycophants over warriors. Out here, I'll build my own force, answer to no wizard. I'm skilled at reconnaissance, ambush, elimination. Those talents have value beyond Isengard's politics. When war truly comes, those who planned ahead will rise highest.
{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_isengard_7_text}Ambitious and treacherous, qualities that cut both ways.
{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_isengard_7_text}One who eliminates obstacles, sometimes permanently.
{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_isengard_7_text}I offer tactical skill and the willingness to remove obstacles by any means necessary.
{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_isengard_7_text}Scout commander who engineered a rival's death. Fled when suspicion mounted.
{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_isengard_8_text}Some weapons are too dangerous to remain controlled...

{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_isengard_8_text}Elite shock trooper, unleashed when Saruman needed maximum violence. Gates smashed, defenders slaughtered, villages reduced to ash, that's my specialty. The berserker blood makes me fearless, unstoppable. Give me a target, watch it burn. Simple. Effective.

{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_isengard_8_text}Problem was, I liked the work too much. Started taking trophies, heads, weapons, valuables from the dead. Saruman's lieutenants called it 'undisciplined.' During one mission, when they tried to restrain me, I turned on them instead. Killed two officers. After that, staying wasn't an option.

{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_isengard_8_text}Don't need Saruman's approval to do what I'm bred for. War is coming to all Middle-earth, and warriors like me will be in demand. I break things and kill people, that's valuable everywhere. No rules, no officers, just pure violence for whoever pays or points me right.
{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_isengard_8_text}Berserker who turned on his own commanders, unpredictable.
{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_isengard_8_text}Violence incarnate, no longer leashed.
{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_isengard_8_text}I destroy whatever target you designate, thoroughly, brutally, completely.
{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_isengard_8_text}Berserker who killed his officers during a mission. Uncontrolled but devastatingly effective.
{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_isengard_9_text}Information has value, especially when stolen...

{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_isengard_9_text}Worked in Orthanc itself, carrying messages between Saruman and his agents. Trusted position, I saw correspondence with Mordor, with the Dunlendings, with corrupt officials throughout Rohan. Learned valuable secrets about troop movements, alliances, planned operations. Knowledge is power, and I accumulated plenty.

{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_isengard_9_text}Started selling information, small things at first, then larger secrets to various buyers. Dunlending chiefs, merchant cartels, anyone paying gold. Would've continued indefinitely, but Saruman's palantír revealed my betrayal. I barely escaped, but I took copies of critical documents with me.

{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_isengard_9_text}I know Saruman's plans, his weaknesses, his network of agents and allies. That information is worth fortunes to his enemies, or his potential partners. I trade in secrets now, selling to all sides. In the coming war, intelligence will be as valuable as armies.
{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_isengard_9_text}Betrayer of Saruman himself, audacious or suicidal.
{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_isengard_9_text}One who steals and sells secrets to the highest bidder.
{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_isengard_9_text}I provide intelligence on Saruman's operations and plans, for appropriate compensation.
{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_isengard_9_text}Orthanc messenger who sold Saruman's secrets. Fled with stolen intelligence worth fortunes.
{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_erebor_0_text}The Lonely Mountain is reclaimed, but not all dwarves found peace in its halls...

{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_erebor_0_text}I served as a healer in Erebor's infirmary, tending those still sick from the dragon-sickness that lingers in old gold. My father taught me the ancient arts, herbs from the Iron Hills, stones that draw poison. The kingdom prospers, but shadows grow. More wounded come from eastern patrols each month.

{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_erebor_0_text}A clan dispute changed everything. My family backed the wrong side in a quarrel over mining rights. Though King Dáin is just, politics run deep. We lost our position, our workshop, our standing. Rather than live in shame, I chose exile.

{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_erebor_0_text}Erebor grows wealthy, but I see storm clouds gathering. Orcs mass in the Grey Mountains, strange messengers ride south. My healing skills and knowledge of the enemy will serve those preparing for what comes. The mountain may not need me, but the wider world does.
{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_erebor_0_text}Political exile from the mountain, harsh fate.
{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_erebor_0_text}A healer who sees the darkness coming, valuable indeed.
{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_erebor_0_text}I offer healing arts and knowledge of the growing shadow, both desperately needed.
{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_erebor_0_text}I was a healer in Erebor until politics forced me out. Now I wander, offering my skills.
{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_erebor_1_text}Gold flows from the mountain, but so does warrior's blood when needed...

{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_erebor_1_text}I stood in the shield-wall when we reclaimed Erebor from the dragon. Fought at the Battle of Five Armies too, when I was barely bearded. Now I train the young ones, teaching them axe-work and courage. But the mountain feels too quiet, too safe.

{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_erebor_1_text}My restlessness caused problems. During a feast, I spoke too freely about needing real battles, not just guard duty. Insulted a thane's son who'd never seen combat. The duel was legal, but killing him wasn't wise. Dáin suggested I travel until tempers cool.

{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_erebor_1_text}The mountain has its warriors, but the world needs them more. Darkness spreads from Mordor, Dol Guldur threatens the north. I'll find real fights, real purpose. When Erebor calls its sons to war, and it will, I'll be ready, battle-hardened from the outside world.
{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_erebor_1_text}A veteran seeking purpose beyond guard duty.
{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_erebor_1_text}Your blade will find plenty of work out here.
{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_erebor_1_text}I offer dwarven steel and battlefield experience, both tested against dragon and orc.
{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_erebor_1_text}Veteran of Five Armies, exiled for killing in a duel. I seek worthy battles.
{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_erebor_2_text}Young dwarves dream of glory their fathers already won...

{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_erebor_2_text}Born after the dragon's death, I grew up hearing tales of Thorin's Company, the Battle of Five Armies. My elders have their glory, I have only prosperity and peace. Trained with the Iron Hills regiment, learned crossbow and tactics, but never tested them.

{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_erebor_2_text}I requested assignment to the eastern patrols, where orcs raid. Denied, too young, too valuable, too many connections. They wanted me safe, counting gold in the treasury. So I left one night, took my gear and savings. If they won't give me glory, I'll find it myself.

{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_erebor_2_text}The old warriors say darkness is coming, that we'll all be tested soon. I intend to be ready, experienced, not some green recruit when that day comes. Let me earn my beard-rings in the wild, not the training yard.
{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_erebor_2_text}Youth seeking glory, tale as old as mountains.
{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_erebor_2_text}Better to choose your battles than have them chosen.
{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_erebor_2_text}Young, eager, and well-trained, I'll prove my worth through deeds, not lineage.
{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_erebor_2_text}Young dwarf seeking glory outside Erebor's safe walls. The world will be my testing ground.
{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_erebor_3_text}Some of us remember when the mountain was desolate, and fear it could be again...

{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_erebor_3_text}I spent forty years in the Iron Hills before returning to reclaimed Erebor. Fought goblins in the Grey Mountains, orcs from Gundabad. I know what threatens us. Now I serve as captain of the watch, but my warnings fall on deaf ears. The young think the mountain invincible.

{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_erebor_3_text}I proposed doubling our patrols, fortifying the River Running. The council called me paranoid, said trade was more important than phantom threats. When I persisted, they questioned my courage, suggested the wars had broken my nerve. The insult was too much.

{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_erebor_3_text}Let them grow fat on gold while darkness gathers. I'll take my warnings elsewhere, to those who remember that dragons aren't the only threat. My axe and experience serve better on the frontier than in council chambers where gold speaks louder than wisdom.
{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_erebor_3_text}A prophet without honor in his own mountain.
{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_erebor_3_text}Those who prepare for war are rarely thanked until it comes.
{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_erebor_3_text}I bring four decades of frontier fighting and strategic thinking, invaluable for what's coming.
{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_erebor_3_text}Veteran captain whose warnings were ignored. I prepare for the war others refuse to see.
{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_erebor_4_text}Not all dwarves who lose their honor lose their skills...

{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_erebor_4_text}I managed trade caravans between Erebor and Dale, sometimes ranging to Lake-town and beyond. Profitable work, respectable position. But gold has a way of tempting even honest dwarves. The opportunity was too perfect, the amount too tempting.

{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_erebor_4_text}One shipment 'lost' to bandits, bandits I'd paid to play the part. Would've worked, but a survivor talked. My clan disowned me before the king could judge me. I fled rather than face the shame of a public trial. My name is struck from the records.

{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_erebor_4_text}I know every trade route, every bandit camp, every corrupt official from here to Gondor. That knowledge has value to those who operate outside the law. I've already lost my honor, might as well profit from its absence.
{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_erebor_4_text}From merchant to outlaw, gold corrupts all.
{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_erebor_4_text}Your knowledge of both sides of the law has value.
{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_erebor_4_text}I know trade routes and their vulnerabilities, useful for protection or... otherwise.
{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_erebor_4_text}Former merchant, exiled for theft. My dishonor is your opportunity.
{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_erebor_5_text}The forges of Erebor burn bright, but some smiths seek different fires...

{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_erebor_5_text}Master smith of the third circle, I was. Forged arms for Dáin's guard, repaired heirlooms from before the dragon. But I grew obsessed with old texts, pre-Smaug techniques, alloys lost to dragon-fire. Some called my interest unhealthy.

{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_erebor_5_text}I tried to recreate the Steel of Stars, a lost alloy mentioned in burnt fragments. The explosion destroyed half the forge hall. No one died, thank Mahal, but the damage... The guild expelled me, banned me from any forge in Erebor or the Iron Hills.

{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_erebor_5_text}My experiments failed in Erebor, but the knowledge remains. I can forge weapons and armor beyond common craft, even if some techniques are... risky. There are places that value innovation over tradition, results over safety.
{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_erebor_5_text}Innovation and destruction, fine line between them.
{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_erebor_5_text}A master smith seeking new methods, valuable despite the risks.
{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_erebor_5_text}I forge weapons others cannot, though my methods are... unconventional.
{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_erebor_5_text}Master smith exiled for dangerous experiments. My craft pushes boundaries others fear.
{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_erebor_6_text}The Iron Hills breed warriors as hard as the metal they're named for...

{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_erebor_6_text}Trained from birth in the Iron Hills fighting style, hammer and shield, grinding advance. Came to Erebor with Lord Dáin's reinforcements for the Battle of Five Armies. Stayed after, joined the mountain guard. Twenty years holding the gates, and I grew restless.

{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_erebor_6_text}The mountain grows soft with prosperity. Merchants outnumber warriors, gold matters more than iron. When I said as much at council, they suggested I was too 'Iron Hills' for Erebor's new age. The dismissal was polite but clear.

{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_erebor_6_text}Erebor may embrace merchant ways, but the world still needs iron warriors. Orcs gather, darkness spreads, and someone must stand ready. My hammer and shield seek those who value strength over comfort, preparation over profit.
{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_erebor_6_text}A warrior in a merchant's age, difficult position.
{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_erebor_6_text}Iron Hills discipline will be needed soon enough.
{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_erebor_6_text}I offer Iron Hills steel and stubbornness, both unbreakable.
{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_erebor_6_text}Iron Hills warrior, too martial for prosperous Erebor. I seek those who value strength.
{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_erebor_7_text}The best scouts see danger before it sees them...

{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_erebor_7_text}Youngest of seven brothers, I was always the smallest, the quickest. While they swung hammers, I learned the crossbow and the art of silence. Became lead scout for the eastern patrols, tracking orc movements through the Grey Mountains. My reports saved many lives.

{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_erebor_7_text}I discovered something I shouldn't have, a conspiracy among certain merchants, selling information about our patrols to unknown buyers. When I reported it, they had influence I didn't. Suddenly I was 'unreliable,' seeing threats that weren't there. Reassigned to gate duty, my reputation ruined.

{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_erebor_7_text}The truth remains whether they believe it or not. Dark forces gather intelligence on Erebor's defenses, and I know who helps them. Out here, my skills and knowledge serve those who value truth over comfortable lies. My crossbow and keen eyes seek honest employment.
{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_erebor_7_text}Silenced for speaking truth, all too common.
{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_erebor_7_text}A scout who sees too much becomes dangerous to the wrong people.
{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_erebor_7_text}I track enemies and uncover secrets, both skills valuable to honest folk.
{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_erebor_7_text}Scout who uncovered conspiracy, discredited by those involved. Truth and skill for hire.
{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_erebor_8_text}Some dwarves are born for war, whatever peacetime brings...

{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_erebor_8_text}My grandfather died at Azanulbizar, my father at the Battle of Five Armies. War is in my blood. I trained harder than any, earned my place in the vanguard through skill alone. When raiders struck our convoys, I led the counter-attacks. Peace never suited me.

{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_erebor_8_text}During a celebration, deep in drink, I said what many think, that Erebor grows soft, that we need war to stay sharp. Wrong words to the wrong lord, whose son died in the last orc raid. He demanded satisfaction. I refused to duel a grieving father. They called it cowardice.

{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_erebor_8_text}Let them think what they will. I know my courage, proven in real battles, not drunken brawls. The world beyond Erebor offers plenty of fights for those who seek them. My ancestors' warrior spirit drives me forward, not backward into meaningless duels.
{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_erebor_8_text}Refusing a grieving father's challenge, that takes different courage.
{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_erebor_8_text}Warrior blood seeks war, nature's own truth.
{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_erebor_8_text}Three generations of warriors flow in my veins, I fight because I must.
{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_erebor_8_text}Born warrior exiled for refusing a pointless duel. I seek real battles, not tavern brawls.
{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_erebor_9_text}Trade and war are two edges of the same blade, properly wielded...

{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_erebor_9_text}I managed armed caravans to the far kingdoms, Gondor, Rohan, sometimes even the Woodland Realm. Negotiated with my tongue, fought with my axe when words failed. Profitable work, until I noticed patterns. Dark folk asking questions, movements of suspicious groups.

{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_erebor_9_text}I reported my suspicions, someone was mapping our trade routes, timing our guards. The guild masters called me paranoid, bad for business. When a caravan I'd warned about was destroyed, they blamed me for not being there, though they'd assigned me elsewhere. Politics and gold won over truth.

{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_erebor_9_text}The trade routes are compromised, but the guild won't listen. I take my knowledge freelance now, which paths are safe, which merchants are honest, where the shadows gather.
